name: discord-plus
description: Discord channel for Claude Code with access control, extended: a server map of channels, roles and emoji, message search with paging, message-link lookup, embed and thread context, attachment detail, forum posting, tagging and closing, message forwarding, native polls, scheduled reminders, a sustained typing indicator, a report-as-bug context menu, opt-in mass mentions, delete and pin, reaction, edit, member and voice events, a member roster, voice-note transcription, and inbound messages read wherever they keep their text: mentions as names, forwards, components-v2 text, polls and stickers.
